name: hip adduction
description: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
